text:
zoe: Anyone else see the nightly evidence-bundler failing after key rotation? upload step errors with decrypt denied.
manny: yup, saw `evidence-bundler/2026-05-02-01` blow up. Error: `403: cryptoKey decrypt denied` when trying to unwrap test secrets.
anita: we rotated sdlc-keystore keys yesterday as part of CLEANUP-772. I scoped down bindings; maybe overzealous.
devsec-bot: Alert: EVIDENCE_PACK_FAIL signature KMS_DECRYPT_ACCESS_DENIED impacted repos: redwood-web, redwood-e2e.
keystore-bot: Event: rotation applied -> key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/sdlc/cryptoKeys/sdlc-key v=3 by anita@redwood.com ts=4955556682.
hugo: is the failing principal the evidence-bundler agent SA or the ephemeral pod?
zoe: stack shows both `serviceAccount:evidence-bundler@redwood-inference` and `serviceAccount:runner-pod@redwood-inference` attempts. both got AccessDenied.
anita: argh, I changed project-level roles but forgot to mirror key-level ACLs for the bundler and runner SAs. my bad.
manny: mitigation options: (A) re-add key-level grant to the two SAs (fast), (B) run a local offline pack and attach artifacts manually (manual), (C) roll back rotation (not ideal).
sre: prefer (A) with a small maintenance window and an audit note.
anita: I'll do a scoped grant and annotate the change. doing it in 2m.
keystore-bot: Audit Event: role.bind key=projects/redwood/.../sdlc-key boundTo=[serviceAccount:evidence-bundler@redwood-inference,serviceAccount:runner-pod@redwood-inference] by anita@redwood.com ts=4955556701
zoe: reran the bundler -> now the pack step completes but DAST upload fails with a signature mismatch to evidence-store (`EVID_SIGN_MISMATCH`). probably unrelated but noticed concurrently.
manny: signature mismatch likely from our signing key rotation; evidence-store expected the old signer. need to coordinate rotate across services.
anita: noted. action: coordinate signing key update for evidence-store in INFRA-1107.
devsec-bot: Action items queued: (1) anita rebind keys (done) (2) manu create INFRA-1107 for signer rotation (3) zoe open SEC-3001 for triage workflow improvements.
zoe: on the SAST finding that came in before the outage: `possible path traversal in file server/serve.py` 1: the SAST pattern flagged `os.path.join` usage. runtime sanitization occurs in `sanitize_path()` earlier. marking provisional FP.
hugo: can we standardize a triage flow: `security:needs-evidence` -> `security:fp-provisional` -> `security:fp-confirmed` and have automation attach runtime evidence (unit test run, env snapshot)?
anita: yes. also suggest we add a suppression workflow for test-only fixtures: a scoped comment `# sec-suppress: TEST_ONLY <ticket>` and require a Jira link.
emergency:
zoe: CI change proposals:
- add `keystore-preflight` job that runs under both runner and pod SA and attempts `keystore decrypt --key $SDLC_KEY --ciphertext sample.ct`
- add `evidence-signer-check` that validates the current signer fingerprint matches evidence-store expected value
- stamp PR template with `RBAC impact` section listing keys and SAs touched and a rollback command snippet (e.g., `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:...`).
manny: also add a small integration test that runs the evidence-bundler against a test keystore to catch regressions.
anita: I'll update the RBAC Playbook: require owner sign-off, a preflight decrypt check, list of affected SAs, and an explicit rollback command. also will add an item to changelog when key ACLs change.
devsec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-3001 "Evidence-bundler RBAC & triage workflow improvements" by zoe@redwood.com ts=4955556728
sre: one more operational note: when rotating keys, include a 30m co-ordination window across infra, sdlc, and security channels and include a smoke test checklist.
zoe: agreed. capturing follow-ups: 1) anita add signer rotation ticket INFRA-1107 (in progress), 2) zoe open SEC-3001 (done), 3) manny add integration test PR, 4) update PR template + RBAC Playbook (anita).
anita: will also add an automated pre-merge check that runs `keystore-preflight` using a short-lived emulator in CI to avoid hitting prod keys.
manny: For the SAST FP we should add an evidence comment on the PR referencing runtime sanitization and link to the unit test proving safe behavior. automation can then apply `security:fp-confirmed` label.
zoe: thanks everyone. closing thread once INFRA-1107 and SEC-3001 have PRs linked. :thumbsup:
